Meaning: Invoice number (6 digits). Starts with 'C' = cancellation.
Product code. Real products start with 5 digits (e.g. 85123A); others are postage, fees or adjustments.
Product name. Can vary slightly for the same StockCode, so StockCode is the product key.
Units per invoice line. Negative = cancellation, return or stock adjustment.
Date and time the invoice was created.
Price per unit in GBP (£). Zero or negative = free items / bad-debt adjustments.
5-digit customer identifier. Missing for ~25% of lines (guest/unregistered).
